Stock market news | IPO Street set for year-end revival; 29 firms eye ₹42,000 crore

On 22 November 2026 BusinessLine reported that despite a recent global equity market sell-off Indian markets remained relatively resilient, restoring investor confidence. The resilience is driving a year-end IPO revival, with 29 firms eyeing about ₹42,000 crore of new capital, showing improved sentiment in the Indian market.
